gloss: right to use; usage rights; license

definitions.gloss: right to use; usage rights; license
definitions.explanation: The legal right to use a piece of property, land, software, or intellectual work, as distinct from owning it.

examples.japanese: {土地|とち}の{使用権|しようけん}を{得|え}る。
examples.english: To obtain the right to use the land.

examples.japanese: このソフトの{使用権|しようけん}は{一年間|いちねんかん}だ。
examples.english: The license to use this software lasts one year.

examples.japanese: {所有権|しょゆうけん}は{移|うつ}らず、{使用権|しようけん}だけが{与|あた}えられる。
examples.english: Ownership does not transfer; only the right to use is granted.

notes:
Formed from {使用|しよう} (use) plus {権|けん} (right). Names the right to use something without necessarily owning it, common in contracts for land, facilities, and software.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {使用権|しようけん}を{与|あた}える: to grant a right of use
- {使用権|しようけん}を{取得|しゅとく}する: to acquire usage rights
- ソフトウェアの{使用権|しようけん}: software license

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {所有権|しょゆうけん}: ownership; title — the right to own, which the usage right does not include
- {利用権|りようけん}: right of use — near-synonym, often for public facilities and services
